verdict.rationale: stagewise documents SKILL.md files that teach the agent "project-specific patterns, workflows, and constraints." That is close to a conventions file, but the evidence frames skills as task-specific and explicitly invoked via slash commands, not as standing project-wide rules. stagewise also auto-generates a WORKSPACE.md in .stagewise/ as the agent's main project understanding, but nothing shows users can edit it to set coding standards the agent always follows. Missing for 10: a documented always-applied project rules/instructions file, evidence that WORKSPACE.md is user-editable for conventions, and hands-on corroboration that the agent follows such standards.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows

citations.quote: Skills are SKILL.md files that give the agent structured instructions for specific tasks. They teach the agent project-specific patterns, workflows, and constraints.
When you connect a workspace, stagewise generates a WORKSPACE.md file in .stagewise/. This is the primary way the agent understands your project at a high level
Invoke skills explicitly with slash commands.
